# Drawing the Old Cut

*Poppy wants to draw the Old Cut as a chart, the way Ambrose would. She asks you to look at two places she cannot reach.*

|---|---|
| Town | [Bain Harbour](../towns/bain_harbour_quests.md) |

## Objectives

- Look at the first lock's gates in [The First Locks](../maps/first_locks.md)
